package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"argparse"
)

func main() {
	p := argparse.New("copy", "Copy a file, optionally several times.")
	verbose := p.Bool("verbose", 'v', "print each step")
	output := p.String("output", 'o', "out.txt", "output file")
	count := p.Int("count", 'n', 1, "number of copies")
	input := p.Arg("input", "file to copy", true)
	p.MustParse()

	fmt.Printf("verbose=%v output=%q count=%d input=%q rest=%q\n",
		*verbose, *output, *count, *input, p.Rest())
}

tool_input.command: gofmt -l . ; go vet ./... && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20 && go run ./example -v -n3 a.txt extra && go run ./example --help; go run ./example; echo "exit=$?"
